description: Cs₂NaCr(CN)₆ is Potassium Silver Cyanide-derived structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Cs is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four N atoms. There are a spread of Cs-N bond distances ranging from 3.31-3.49 Å. Na is bonded in an octahedral geometry to six N atoms. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.50-2.56 Å. Cr is bonded in an octahedral geometry to six C atoms. All Cr-C bond lengths are 2.04 Å. There are three inequivalent C sites. In the first C site, C is bonded in a linear geometry to one Cr and one N atom. The C-N bond length is 1.18 Å. In the second C site, C is bonded in a linear geometry to one Cr and one N atom. The C-N bond length is 1.18 Å. In the third C site, C is bonded in a linear geometry to one Cr and one N atom. The C-N bond length is 1.18 Å. There are three inequivalent N sites. In the first N site, N is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to two equivalent Cs, one Na, and one C atom. In the second N site, N is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Cs, one Na, and one C atom. In the third N site, N is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Cs, one Na, and one C atom.
